subject: youtube.channel_operating_system.current
summary: Channel Operating System v1.2 Studio-Benchmarked is the current production method. It adopts professional YouTube studio disciplines from Kurzgesagt, Veritasium, Simplicissimus/fern, Cleo Abram/Huge If True and Johnny Harris while preserving a small functions-not-headcount model.

adopted_disciplines: Visual Story Case before script lock
Pre-production Craft Review with editor/art/sound before script lock
Separate Claim Source and Visual Source/Rights ledgers
Production Readiness Gate before expensive production
Packaging Stage A before script and Stage B after rough cut
Motion Editor as early story partner
details.staffing_rule: functions_not_headcount; combine execution during pilot when efficient, preserve independent clearance boundaries

verification.full_company_tests: 278 PASS, 1 expected skip after coverage-fix commit
